definitions.explanation: An arc of colors visible in the sky, caused by the refraction and dispersion of sunlight through rain droplets.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨上|あめあ}がり→雨上がり：14586_ameagari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{虹|にじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: A rainbow appeared after the rain stopped.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{虹|にじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかっている→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: A large rainbow stretches across the sky.

examples.japanese: {虹|にじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ると→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{幸|しあわ}せ→幸せ：01420_shiawase⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Seeing a rainbow makes me feel happy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子|こ}ども→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{虹|にじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指|ゆび}さして→指さす：12815_yubisasu⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}んでいた→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧。
examples.english: The children were pointing at the rainbow with delight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夕立|ゆうだち}→夕立：05862_yuudachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|や}んだ→止む：01153_yamu⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{東|ひがし}→東：02250_higashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧{虹|にじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかっていて→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧、⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}った→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
examples.english: After the evening shower stopped, a beautiful rainbow appeared in the eastern sky, and we all took photos.

notes:
{虹|にじ} refers to the natural phenomenon of a rainbow.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {虹|にじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧ (a rainbow appears/spans across)
- {虹|にじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (a rainbow appears)
- ⟦{虹色|にじいろ}→虹色：28257_nijiiro⟧ (rainbow colors)
- ⟦{二重|にじゅう}→二重：16893_nijuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{虹|にじ} (double rainbow)

JAPANESE COLOR TRADITION:
In Japanese tradition, rainbows are often described as having 7 colors: ⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧、⟦{橙|だいだい}→橙：21180_daidai⟧、⟦{黄|き}→黄：19352_ki⟧、⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧、⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧、⟦{藍|あい}→藍：20100_ai⟧、⟦{紫|むらさき}→紫：00297_murasaki⟧ (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, violet).
